_comment: How Natural Earth 5.1.1 modern admin-0 entities map to the states that existed on 1990-01-01. Hand-authored; edit here, not in code.

excluded.ATA: Antarctica is out of scope (guide section 3A)
excluded.PGA: Spratly Islands: tiny, no sovereign in 1990
excluded.SPI: Southern Patagonian Ice Field: overlaps Chile and Argentina

notes: Berlin is assigned whole to East Germany so West Berlin is not an enclave.
Namibia is kept independent although South Africa administered it until 1990-03-21.
Western Sahara goes to Morocco; Northern Cyprus to Cyprus; Palestine (West Bank, Gaza) to Israel; Eritrea to Ethiopia; South Sudan to Sudan; Timor-Leste to Indonesia; Kosovo to Yugoslavia.
Hong Kong goes to the United Kingdom and Macau to Portugal.
Palau goes to the United States (UN trust territory in 1990).
Admin-1 Al Bayda' is assigned to North Yemen although part of it was in South Yemen.
